index 0000000000..a21d2d5a16
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tools/pixelelated-cloud-folder-test
@@ -0,0 +1,369 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Explicit cloud folders against isolated real rclone filesystems (#508).
+
+This is a fast regression control, not VM/image qualification. Every case
+gets independent synthetic config and cloud bytes. The old implementation
+can be exercised with --ref, including its retired migration helper.
+"""
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import importlib.machinery
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+loader = importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader('layout_fixture', str(ROOT/'tools/rasteratops-cloud-layout-test'))
+spec = importlib.util.spec_from_loader(loader.name, loader)
+legacy = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+loader.exec_module(legacy)
+require, put = legacy.require, legacy.put
+
+
+def digest_tree(path):
+    return {str(p.relative_to(path)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+            for p in sorted(path.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}
+
+
+def snapshot(f):
+    return (f.path.joinpath('storage/.config/cloud_sync.conf').read_bytes(), digest_tree(f.path/'cloud'))
+
+
+def facts(result):
+    return dict(line.split('=', 1) for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if '=' in line and not line.startswith('>>>'))
+
+
+def good(f, script, *args):
+    r = f.run(script, *args)
+    require(r.returncode == 0, f'{script} {args}: rc={r.returncode}: {r.stdout[-800:]}')
+    return r
+
+
+def read_only(f, root, populated=True):
+    if root != '/pixelelated':
+        f.conf(root+'/Saves', root+'/Backups', root+'/Content')
+    if populated:
+        f.file(root+'/Saves/gb/progress.srm', 'configured save\n')
+    f.file('/ROCKNIX/Content/ROMs/psx/cloud-only.chd', 'cloud-only game sentinel\n')
+    f.file('/pixelelated/Content/ROMs/gb/current.gb', 'current game sentinel\n')
+    before = snapshot(f)
+    r = good(f, 'cloud_setup', '--folder-state')
+    require(facts(r).get('STATE') == ('ready' if populated else 'missing'), r.stdout)
+    require(facts(r).get('SAVES') == root+'/Saves', r.stdout)
+    good(f, 'cloud_scan', '--folder')
+    good(f, 'cloud_setup', '--content-location')
+    require(snapshot(f) == before, 'read-only folder/content discovery changed cloud/config bytes')
+
+
+def seed(f, root, content=None):
+    f.conf(root+'/Saves', root+'/Backups', root+'/Content' if content is None else content)
+    f.file('/ROCKNIX/Saves/gb/old.srm', 'legacy save\n')
+    f.file('/ROCKNIX/Content/ROMs/psx/cloud-only.chd', 'unrepresented library\n')
+    f.file(root+'/Saves/README.txt', 'owner note retained\n')
+    before_conf, before_cloud = snapshot(f)
+    good(f, 'cloud_setup', '--seed-folders')
+    after_conf, after_cloud = snapshot(f)
+    require(after_conf == before_conf, 'seeding rewrote selected paths')
+    require(all(after_cloud.get(k) == v for k, v in before_cloud.items()), 'seeding changed existing cloud bytes')
+    require((f.path/'cloud'/root.lstrip('/')/'Backups/README.txt').exists(), 'no selected backup stub')
+    c = (root+'/Content') if content is None else content.rstrip('/')
+    require((f.path/'cloud'/c.lstrip('/')/'ROMs/README.txt').exists(), 'no selected ROM stub')
+    require((f.path/'cloud'/c.lstrip('/')/'BIOS/README.txt').exists(), 'no selected BIOS stub')
+    if content in ('', '/'):
+        require(not (f.path/'cloud/README.txt').exists(), 'content-root seeding wrote a cloud-root README')
+    if root != '/pixelelated':
+        require(not (f.path/'cloud/pixelelated').exists(), 'custom/legacy choice created the default namespace')
+    before = snapshot(f)
+    good(f, 'cloud_setup', '--seed-folders')
+    require(snapshot(f) == before, 'repeat seeding changed existing bytes/config')
+
+
+def fresh_beside_legacy(f):
+    f.file('/ROCKNIX/Saves/gb/progress.srm','old save\n')
+    f.file('/ROCKNIX/Content/ROMs/psx/CloudOnly.chd','cloud-only game\n')
+    before_conf, before_cloud=snapshot(f)
+    good(f,'cloud_setup','--seed-folders')
+    after_conf, after_cloud=snapshot(f)
+    require(before_conf==after_conf,'fresh seeding silently joined legacy paths')
+    require(all(after_cloud.get(k)==v for k,v in before_cloud.items()),'fresh seeding changed legacy data')
+    require((f.path/'cloud/pixelelated/Saves/README.txt').exists(),'fresh setup did not seed pixelelated')
+
+
+def scan_never_follows(f):
+    f.conf('/ROCKNIX/Saves','/ROCKNIX/Backups','/ROCKNIX/Content')
+    f.file('/pixelelated/Saves/gb/progress.srm','current save\n')
+    f.file('/pixelelated/.layout','layout=2\n')
+    before=snapshot(f)
+    good(f,'cloud_scan','--folder')
+    require(snapshot(f)==before,'scan silently followed another device to current paths')
+    state=legacy.read_facts(f.path/'storage/.cache/cloud_sync/scan/state')
+    require(state.get('STATE')=='missing' and state.get('SAVES')=='/ROCKNIX/Saves',str(state))
+
+
+def guard(f, kind):
+    f.file('/pixelelated/Saves/gb/progress.srm', 'keep\n')
+    if kind=='relative-future':
+        f.conf('pixelelated/Saves','pixelelated/Backups','pixelelated/Content')
+    if kind in ('future', 'relative-future', 'malformed', 'marker-denied'):
+        f.file('/pixelelated/.layout', 'layout=999\n' if kind in ('future','relative-future') else 'layout=2\nextra\n' if kind == 'malformed' else 'layout=2\n')
+    if kind == 'marker-denied': f.fault(r'^cat qa:/pixelelated/\.layout ', 5)
+    if kind == 'list-denied': f.fault(r'^lsf ', 5)
+    if kind == 'config':
+        with (f.path/'storage/.config/cloud_sync.conf').open('a') as fp: fp.write('CONTENT_REMOTE="$(touch /storage/should-not-exist)"\n')
+        # The first assignment is canonical; corrupt that one, not a shadow duplicate.
+        p=f.path/'storage/.config/cloud_sync.conf';p.write_text(p.read_text().replace('CONTENT_REMOTE="/pixelelated/Content"','CONTENT_REMOTE="$(touch /storage/should-not-exist)"'))
+    before = snapshot(f)
+    for script, flag in [('cloud_setup', '--folder-state'), ('cloud_scan', '--folder'), ('cloud_setup', '--seed-folders')]:
+        r=f.run(script, flag)
+        require(r.returncode != 0 and '>>> why ' in r.stdout, f'{kind} incorrectly succeeded: {r.stdout}')
+        require(snapshot(f) == before, f'{kind} refusal changed config/cloud bytes')
+    require(not (f.path/'storage/should-not-exist').exists(), 'config was evaluated')
+
+
+def write_refused(f, kind):
+    f.file('/pixelelated/Saves/gb/progress.srm','keep\n')
+    f.fault(r'^mkdir ' if kind=='mkdir' else r'^copyto --ignore-existing ', 5)
+    before_conf, before_cloud=snapshot(f)
+    r=f.run('cloud_setup','--seed-folders')
+    require(r.returncode != 0 and "COULDN'T BE CREATED" in r.stdout, 'write failure reported success')
+    after_conf, after_cloud=snapshot(f)
+    require(before_conf == after_conf and all(after_cloud.get(k)==v for k,v in before_cloud.items()), 'write failure damaged prior data/settings')
+    require((f.path/'ctl/fault-fired').exists(), 'fault was not exercised')
+
+
+def explicit(f):
+    f.conf('/ROCKNIX/Saves','/ROCKNIX/Backups','/ROCKNIX/Content')
+    f.file('/ROCKNIX/Saves/gb/old.srm','old\n')
+    before=digest_tree(f.path/'cloud')
+    good(f,'cloud_setup','--set-saves-remote','/Selected/Saves')
+    p=f.pointers()
+    require((p['SAVES_REMOTE'],p['SETTINGS_REMOTE'],p['CONTENT_REMOTE']) == ('/Selected/Saves','/Selected/Backups','/Selected/Content'), 'explicit sibling selection incorrect')
+    good(f,'cloud_setup','--set-content-remote','/Other')
+    p=f.pointers()
+    require((p['SAVES_REMOTE'],p['SETTINGS_REMOTE'],p['CONTENT_REMOTE']) == ('/Selected/Saves','/Selected/Backups','/Other'), 'content-only choice changed sibling paths')
+    require(digest_tree(f.path/'cloud') == before, 'selecting a path moved/created cloud data')
+
+
+def partial(f):
+    f.file('/pixelelated/Content/ROMs/gb/Remote.gb','remote game\n')
+    f.file('/pixelelated/Content/ROMs/psx/CloudOnly.chd','cloud-only content\n')
+    put(f.path/'storage/roms/gb/Local.gb','local game\n')
+    put(f.path/'storage/.config/emulationstation/es_systems.cfg','<systemList>\n<path>/storage/roms/gb</path>\n<path>/storage/roms/psx</path>\n</systemList>\n')
+    before_conf,before_cloud=snapshot(f)
+    good(f,'cloud_content_backup','gb')
+    after=digest_tree(f.path/'cloud')
+    require(all(after.get(k)==v for k,v in before_cloud.items()), 'partial local library deleted/changed cloud-only content')
+    require((f.path/'cloud/pixelelated/Content/ROMs/gb/Local.gb').read_text()=='local game\n','selected content not backed up')
+    good(f,'cloud_content_restore','gb')
+    require((f.path/'storage/roms/gb/Remote.gb').read_text()=='remote game\n','selected content not restored')
+    require(not (f.path/'storage/roms/psx/CloudOnly.chd').exists(),'unselected system was restored')
+    require(f.path.joinpath('storage/.config/cloud_sync.conf').read_bytes()==before_conf,'transfer rewrote folder selection')
+
+
+def case_alias(f, mode):
+    f.conf('/Pixelelated/Saves','/Pixelelated/Backups','/Pixelelated/Content')
+    f.file('/Pixelelated/.layout','layout=999\n')
+    shim=f.path/'shim/rclone'
+    original=shim.read_text()
+    value={'folding':'true','sensitive':'false','unknown':'null'}[mode]
+    response=json.dumps({'Features':{'CaseInsensitive':{'folding':True,'sensitive':False,'unknown':None}[mode]}})
+    shim.write_text(original.replace('exec /rclone.real', 'if [ "$1 $2" = "backend features" ]; then echo '+repr(response)+'; exit 0; fi\nexec /rclone.real'))
+    before_conf,before_cloud=snapshot(f)
+    r=f.run('cloud_setup','--seed-folders')
+    after_conf,after_cloud=snapshot(f)
+    require(before_conf==after_conf and all(after_cloud.get(k)==v for k,v in before_cloud.items()),'case alias changed existing data')
+    if mode=='sensitive':
+        require(r.returncode==0 and 'Pixelelated/Saves/README.txt' in after_cloud,'case-sensitive custom namespace was treated as default')
+        require(not (f.path/'cloud/pixelelated').exists(),'case-sensitive spelling was rewritten')
+    else:
+        require(r.returncode!=0 and before_cloud==after_cloud,'case folding or unknown provider bypassed format guard')
+
+
+def dot_root(f, tier):
+    values={'saves':'/Mine/Saves','backups':'/Mine/Backups','content':'/Mine/Content'}
+    values[tier]='./'
+    f.conf(**values)
+    f.file('/owner.txt','root sentinel\n')
+    before=snapshot(f)
+    for script,flag in [('cloud_setup','--folder-state'),('cloud_setup','--seed-folders')]:
+        r=f.run(script,flag)
+        require(r.returncode!=0 and '>>> why ' in r.stdout,'dot-only '+tier+' path was silently treated as a fresh default')
+        require(snapshot(f)==before,'dot-only path refusal changed prior data/config')
+
+
+def relative_empty(f, path):
+    f.conf(path,'/Mine/Backups','/Mine/Content')
+    f.directory(path)
+    before=snapshot(f)
+    result=good(f,'cloud_setup','--folder-state')
+    require(facts(result).get('STATE')=='ready',result.stdout)
+    require(snapshot(f)==before,'empty-folder read changed cloud/config')
+
+
+def relative_home(f, absolute):
+    # A controlled mapping models SFTP's home-relative vs absolute namespaces.
+    # Real rclone reads two different local trees; this is not a live SFTP proof.
+    path='/GAMES' if absolute else 'GAMES'
+    f.conf(path,'/Other/Backups','/Other/Content')
+    f.directory('/GAMES' if absolute else '/home/<account>')
+    shim=f.path/'shim/rclone'
+    mapping='''mapped=()
+for arg in "$@"; do
+ case "$arg" in qa:) arg=qa:/home;; qa:/*) ;; qa:*) arg="qa:/home/${arg#qa:}";; esac
+ mapped+=("$arg")
+done
+exec /rclone.real "${mapped[@]}"
+'''
+    shim.write_text(shim.read_text().replace('exec /rclone.real "$@"',mapping))
+    before=snapshot(f)
+    result=good(f,'cloud_setup','--folder-state')
+    require(facts(result).get('STATE')=='ready',result.stdout)
+    expected='lsf --dirs-only qa:/ --' if absolute else 'lsf --dirs-only qa: --'
+    require(expected in (f.path/'ctl/argv').read_text(),'parent lookup changed absolute/home-relative meaning')
+    require(snapshot(f)==before,'namespace read changed cloud/config')
+
+
+def partial_readback(f, mode, code):
+    f.conf('/Mine/Saves','/Mine/Backups','/Mine/Content')
+    f.file('/Mine/Saves/gb/progress.srm','existing progress\n')
+    before_conf,before_cloud=snapshot(f)
+    if mode=='direct':
+        injection='''if [ "$1 $2" = "lsf qa:/Mine/Saves" ]; then
+ printf 'direct partial listing\n' >> /ctl/fault-fired
+ printf 'README.txt\n'; exit CODE
+fi
+'''
+    else:
+        injection='''if [ "$1 $2" = "lsf qa:/Mine/Saves" ]; then
+ printf 'direct empty failed listing\n' >> /ctl/fault-fired
+ exit 5
+fi
+if [ "$1 $2 $3" = "lsf --dirs-only qa:/Mine/" ]; then
+ printf 'parent partial listing\n' >> /ctl/fault-fired
+ printf 'Saves/\n'; exit CODE
+fi
+'''
+    shim=f.path/'shim/rclone';shim.write_text(shim.read_text().replace('exec /rclone.real',injection.replace('CODE',str(code))+'exec /rclone.real'))
+    result=f.run('cloud_setup','--seed-folders')
+    after_conf,after_cloud=snapshot(f)
+    require(result.returncode!=0 and 'OK /Mine/Saves' not in result.stdout,'failed final listing was reported as successful presence')
+    require((f.path/'ctl/fault-fired').exists(),'final readback control never fired')
+    require(before_conf==after_conf and all(after_cloud.get(k)==v for k,v in before_cloud.items()),'late failure damaged existing data/config')
+
+
+def carried_root(f):
+    f.conf('/','/','/Games')
+    f.file('/owner.txt','root sentinel\n')
+    before_conf,before_cloud=snapshot(f)
+    state=good(f,'cloud_setup','--folder-state')
+    require(facts(state).get('SAVES')=='/' and facts(state).get('BACKUPS')=='/',state.stdout)
+    good(f,'cloud_setup','--seed-folders')
+    after_conf,after_cloud=snapshot(f)
+    require(before_conf==after_conf,'carried root was rewritten')
+    require(all(after_cloud.get(k)==v for k,v in before_cloud.items()),'carried root bytes changed')
+    require('README.txt' in after_cloud and not any(k.startswith('pixelelated/') for k in after_cloud),'carried root was silently defaulted')
+
+
+def interrupted_state(f):
+    f.conf('/pixelelated/Saves','/pixelelated/Backups','/ROCKNIX/Content')
+    record=f.path/'storage/.config/cloud-layout-migration.json'
+    put(record,json.dumps({'schema':1,'step':1,'from':1,'to':2,'remote':'qa:','fingerprint':'synthetic-fingerprint','fingerprint_format':'rclone-json-v1','source':{'saves':'/ROCKNIX/Saves','backups':'/ROCKNIX/Backups','content':'/ROCKNIX/Content','discarded':'/ROCKNIX/Saves-replaced'},'configured':{'saves':'/ROCKNIX/Saves','backups':'/ROCKNIX/Backups','content':'/ROCKNIX/Content'},'stage':'discarded'})+'\n')
+    f.file('/pixelelated/Saves/gb/progress.srm','already migrated save\n')
+    f.file('/ROCKNIX/Content/ROMs/psx/CloudOnly.chd','remaining cloud-only game\n')
+    credential=(f.path/'storage/.config/rclone/rclone.conf').read_bytes()
+    recovery=record.read_bytes()
+    before_conf,before_cloud=snapshot(f)
+    good(f,'cloud_scan','--folder')
+    good(f,'cloud_setup','--seed-folders')
+    after_conf,after_cloud=snapshot(f)
+    require(after_conf==before_conf,'interrupted-state pointers changed')
+    require(record.read_bytes()==recovery,'legacy recovery record was changed')
+    require((f.path/'storage/.config/rclone/rclone.conf').read_bytes()==credential,'credentials were changed')
+    require(all(after_cloud.get(k)==v for k,v in before_cloud.items()),'interrupted cloud bytes changed')
+    require(not (f.path/'cloud/pixelelated/Content').exists(),'remaining content was automatically adopted')
+
+
+def no_remote(f):
+    put(f.path/'storage/.config/rclone/rclone.conf','')
+    before=snapshot(f)
+    r=f.run('cloud_setup','--folder-state')
+    require(r.returncode==1 and facts(r).get('STATE')=='no-remote',r.stdout)
+    require(snapshot(f)==before,'no-remote read changed state')
+
+
+def main():
+    p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    p.add_argument('--output',required=True,type=Path)
+    p.add_argument('--rclone',required=True)
+    p.add_argument('--ref')
+    p.add_argument('--case')
+    p.add_argument('--retire',action='store_true',help='retire disposable fixture data after sealing compact receipts')
+    a=p.parse_args()
+    a.output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
+    cases={
+      'fresh-empty-seed-beside-legacy':fresh_beside_legacy,
+      'scan-never-follows':scan_never_follows,
+      'read-current':lambda f:read_only(f,'/pixelelated'),
+      'read-legacy':lambda f:read_only(f,'/ROCKNIX'),
+      'read-legacy-missing':lambda f:read_only(f,'/ROCKNIX',False),
+      'read-custom':lambda f:read_only(f,'/Mine'),
+      'fresh-seed-beside-legacy':lambda f:seed(f,'/pixelelated'),
+      'legacy-seed':lambda f:seed(f,'/ROCKNIX'),
+      'custom-seed':lambda f:seed(f,'/Mine'),
+      'empty-content-root':lambda f:seed(f,'/Mine',''),
+      'slash-content-root':lambda f:seed(f,'/Mine','/'),
+      'guard-future':lambda f:guard(f,'future'),
+      'guard-relative-future':lambda f:guard(f,'relative-future'),
+      'carried-root':carried_root,
+      'empty-relative-games':lambda f:relative_empty(f,'GAMES'),
+      'empty-relative-saves':lambda f:relative_empty(f,'Saves'),
+      'empty-absolute-games':lambda f:relative_empty(f,'/GAMES'),
+      'empty-relative-nested':lambda f:relative_empty(f,'Mine/Saves'),
+      'home-relative-namespace':lambda f:relative_home(f,False),
+      'absolute-namespace':lambda f:relative_home(f,True),
+      **{f'partial-{mode}-rc{code}':(lambda f,m=mode,c=code:partial_readback(f,m,c)) for mode in ['direct','parent'] for code in [3,4,5]},
+      'dot-saves-refused':lambda f:dot_root(f,'saves'),
+      'dot-backups-refused':lambda f:dot_root(f,'backups'),
+      'dot-content-refused':lambda f:dot_root(f,'content'),
+      'case-folding-guard':lambda f:case_alias(f,'folding'),
+      'case-sensitive-custom':lambda f:case_alias(f,'sensitive'),
+      'case-unknown-refused':lambda f:case_alias(f,'unknown'),
+      'guard-malformed':lambda f:guard(f,'malformed'),
+      'guard-marker-denied':lambda f:guard(f,'marker-denied'),
+      'guard-list-denied':lambda f:guard(f,'list-denied'),
+      'guard-config':lambda f:guard(f,'config'),
+      'mkdir-denied':lambda f:write_refused(f,'mkdir'),
+      'readme-denied':lambda f:write_refused(f,'readme'),
+      'explicit-selection':explicit,'partial-library':partial,'no-remote':no_remote,
+      'archive-roundtrip':legacy.archive_roundtrip,'interrupted-state':interrupted_state,
+    }
+    if a.case:
+        require(a.case in cases,'unknown case');cases={a.case:cases[a.case]}
+    results=[]
+    for name, fn in cases.items():
+        f=legacy.Fixture(a.output/name,a)
+        if a.ref:
+            old=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(ROOT),'show',a.ref+':'+str(legacy.SOURCES/'cloud_migrate_layout')],capture_output=True)
+            if old.returncode==0:
+                (f.path/'repo/cloud_migrate_layout').write_bytes(old.stdout);(f.path/'repo/cloud_migrate_layout').chmod(0o755)
+        try:
+            fn(f);status='PASS';detail=''
+        except Exception as exc:
+            status='FAIL';detail=str(exc)
+        result={'case':name,'status':status,'detail':detail,'cloud_sha256':digest_tree(f.path/'cloud'),'pointers':f.pointers()}
+        (f.path/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
+        results.append(result);print(status,name,detail,flush=True)
+        if a.retire:
+            traces=f.path/'traces';traces.mkdir()
+            for src in (f.path/'ctl').iterdir():
+                if src.is_file(): shutil.copyfile(src,traces/src.name)
+            for name in ('repo','shim','storage','cloud','ctl','log','run'):
+                shutil.rmtree(f.path/name)
+            (f.path/'retired.json').write_text(json.dumps({'synthetic_payloads_removed':True,'cloud_hashes_in':'result.json'})+'\n')
+    (a.output/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps({'ref':a.ref,'results':results},indent=2)+'\n')
+    return int(any(r['status']!='PASS' for r in results))
+
+if __name__=='__main__':sys.exit(main())

new file mode 100755
index 0000000000..bcbe7ed574

+++ b/tools/pixelelated-cloud-folder-vm-test
@@ -0,0 +1,172 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""One disposable candidate guest + synthetic WebDAV for explicit folders (#508).
+
+This verifies a hash-bound source overlay, not assembled firmware inclusion.
+With --keep-guest, ownership is handed off in guest.json for the UI proof; the
+next owner must use vm-stop and cloud-test-backend down, then retire the disk.

+import hashlib

+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

+def sha(path):

+
+def main():

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Real local-rclone controls for bounded category validation (#508/#510).
+
+Synthetic host fixtures only; image/VM qualification remains a separate gate.
+Retains raw command results, literal rclone argv and immutable source hashes.
+"""
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import importlib.machinery
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import time
+import sys
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+loader = importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader('layout_fixture', str(ROOT/'tools/rasteratops-cloud-layout-test'))
+spec = importlib.util.spec_from_loader(loader.name, loader)
+legacy = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+loader.exec_module(legacy)
+require, put = legacy.require, legacy.put
+
+
+def snapshot(f):
+    return {str(p.relative_to(f.path)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+            for area in ('storage', 'cloud') for p in sorted((f.path/area).rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}
+
+
+def request(f, categories='saves,settings,roms,bios,media', run='proof01', rc=0):
+    before = snapshot(f)
+    r = f.run('cloud_setup', '--validate-folders', categories, run)
+    require(r.returncode == rc, f'rc={r.returncode}, expected {rc}: {r.stdout}')
+    value = json.loads(r.stdout)
+    require(snapshot(f) == before, 'validation changed local/cloud bytes')
+    require(value['run_id'] == run, 'run identity absent')
+    return value
+
+
+def rows(value):
+    return {r['category']:r for r in value['categories']}
+
+
+def initial(f):
+    put(f.path/'storage/roms/gb/.fixture', 'local known system\n')
+    put(f.path/'storage/roms/snes/.fixture', 'local known system\n')
+
+
+def main():
+    p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    p.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
+    p.add_argument('--rclone', default=shutil.which('rclone'))
+    p.add_argument('--case', action='append')
+    p.add_argument('--ref', help='Read historical product sources from this commit')
+    a=p.parse_args()
+    version=subprocess.check_output([a.rclone,'version'],text=True).splitlines()[0]
+    require(version == 'rclone v1.75.1', 'Use the package-pinned rclone1.75.1, not the host fallback: '+version)
+    require(not a.output.exists(), 'use a new output directory')
+    a.output.mkdir(parents=True)
+    results=[]
+    def case(name, work):
+        if a.case and name not in a.case:return
+        f=legacy.Fixture(a.output/name,a);initial(f)
+        work(f)
+        results.append(name);print('PASS '+name,flush=True)
+
+    def complete(f):
+        f.file('pixelelated/Saves/gb/progress.srm')
+        f.file('pixelelated/Backups/QA-id/2026_10_01-QA-ROCKNIX_SETTINGS.tar.gz')
+        f.file('pixelelated/Content/ROMs/gb/Game.gb')
+        f.file('pixelelated/Content/ROMs/gb/images/Game.png')
+        f.file('pixelelated/Content/BIOS/firmware.bin')
+        result=request(f)
+        require(result['complete'] and all(x['state']=='present' for x in result['categories']),str(result))
+        argv=(f.path/'ctl/argv').read_text()
+        require(not any(line.startswith(('copy','move','sync','cat ','mkdir','rcat','delete')) for line in argv.splitlines()),argv)
+        require(not any(line.startswith('lsjson qa: ') or line.startswith('lsjson qa:/ ') for line in argv.splitlines()),argv)
+    case('populated-read-only',complete)
+
+    def filtered_content(f):
+        excluded=['only.'+ext for ext in ['srm','sav','fs','state1','auto','dsv','eep','mpk','sra','fla','mcd','mcr']]
+        excluded+=['only (a conflicted copy).gb','only.sync-conflict-01.gb','only.12345678.partial','save/game.bin','memcards/game.bin','PPSSPP/game.bin','shared/savefiles/game.bin','README.txt']
+        for base in ('pixelelated/Content/ROMs/gb','pixelelated/Content/BIOS'):
+            for name in excluded:f.file(base+'/'+name)
+        result=request(f,'roms,bios')
+        require(all(row['state']=='empty' for row in result['categories']),str(result))
+        f.file('pixelelated/Content/ROMs/gb/Game.gb');f.file('pixelelated/Content/BIOS/firmware.bin')
+        require(all(row['state']=='present' for row in request(f,'roms,bios')['categories']),'real ROM/BIOS not recognized')
+    case('content-transfer-exclusions',filtered_content)
+
+    def flat_roms(f):
+        base='pixelelated/Content/ROMs/'
+        for name in ['README.txt','.layout','gamelist.xml','only.srm','only.eep','only.mcr','only (a conflicted copy).gb','only.sync-conflict-01.gb','only.12345678.partial']:
+            f.file(base+name)
+        f.file(base+'gb/images/Game.png')
+        initial_rows=rows(request(f,'roms,media'))
+        require(initial_rows['roms']['state']=='empty' and initial_rows['media']['state']=='present',str(initial_rows))
+        f.file(base+'qa.gb')
+        misplaced=rows(request(f,'roms,media'))
+        require(misplaced['roms']['state']=='misplaced' and misplaced['roms']['detail']=='files-outside-system-folders',str(misplaced))
+        require(misplaced['media']['state']=='present','flat ROM obscured valid media')
+        f.file(base+'gb/Game.gb')
+        require(rows(request(f,'roms'))['roms']['state']=='misplaced','valid ROM hid out-of-folder payload')
+        (f.path/'cloud'/base/'qa.gb').unlink()
+        require(rows(request(f,'roms'))['roms']['state']=='present','proper system ROM not recognized')
+    case('flat-rom-payload-location',flat_roms)
+
+    def progress_allowlist(f):
+        for name in ['savefiles/history.db','savestates/history.sqlite3','screenshots/history.db-wal','gb/UPPER.SAV','psx/not-memcards/card.mcd','n64/save/wrong.bin','backup/settings.zip']:
+            f.file('pixelelated/Saves/'+name)
+        require(rows(request(f,'saves'))['saves']['state']=='empty','excluded/database/archive counted as progress')
+        for ext in ('eep','mpk','sra','fla'):
+            f.file('pixelelated/Saves/n64/Game.'+ext)
+        f.file('pixelelated/Saves/psx/memcards/card.mcr')
+        require(rows(request(f,'saves'))['saves']['state']=='present','standalone progress not recognized')
+    case('ordinary-progress-allowlist',progress_allowlist)
+
+    def missing(f):
+        f.file('Elsewhere/ROMs/gb/Game.gb')
+        value=request(f);r=rows(value)
+        require(all(x['state']=='missing' for x in r.values()),str(value))
+        require('Elsewhere' not in (f.path/'ctl/argv').read_text(),'account traversal')
+    case('missing-selected-only',missing)
+
+    def empty(f):
+        for path in ('Saves','Backups','Content/ROMs/gb','Content/BIOS'):f.directory('pixelelated/'+path)
+        for path in ('Saves','Backups','Content/ROMs','Content/BIOS'):f.file('pixelelated/'+path+'/README.txt')
+        require(all(x['state']=='empty' for x in request(f)['categories']),'README or empty system counted as payload')
+    case('empty-and-notes',empty)
+
+    def empty_physical(f):
+        f.directory('pixelelated/Saves')
+        require(rows(request(f,'saves'))['saves']['state']=='empty','path-based empty failed')
+    case('empty-path-based',empty_physical)
+
+    def empty_bucket(f):
+        f.directory('pixelelated/Saves');put(f.path/'ctl/bucket','yes')
+        r=rows(request(f,'saves',rc=5))['saves']
+        require(r['state']=='unreadable' and r['detail']=='folder-presence-unconfirmed',str(r))
+        f.file('pixelelated/Saves/README.txt')
+        require(rows(request(f,'saves'))['saves']['state']=='empty','README prefix witness ignored')
+        require('lsjson qa: ' not in (f.path/'ctl/argv').read_text(),'bucket parent outside scope listed')
+    case('bucket-empty-prefix-uncertainty',empty_bucket)
+
+
+    def misplaced(f):
+        f.file('pixelelated/Content/gb/Game.gb');f.file('pixelelated/Content/bios/firmware.bin')
+        f.file('pixelelated/Saves/Saves/gb/progress.srm')
+        r=rows(request(f,'saves,roms,bios'))
+        require(r['saves']['state']=='present' and r['roms']['state']=='misplaced' and r['bios']['state']=='misplaced',str(r))
+    case('content-misplaced-progress-preserved',misplaced)
+
+    def failures(f):
+        f.directory('pixelelated/Saves');f.fault('^lsjson qa:/pixelelated/Saves ',5)
+        result=request(f,'saves',rc=5)
+        require(not result['complete'] and rows(result)['saves']['state']=='unreadable',str(result))
+    case('provider-failure-not-empty',failures)
+
+    def inject(f, body):
+        original=(f.path/'shim/rclone').read_text()
+        put(f.path/'shim/rclone',original.replace('exec /rclone.real "$@"',body+'\nexec /rclone.real "$@"'),True)
+
+    def partial(f):
+        inject(f,'''if [ "$1" = lsjson ]; then printf '[{"Path":"gb/progress.srm","IsDir":false}]'; exit 3; fi''')
+        result=request(f,'saves',rc=5)
+        require(rows(result)['saves']['state']=='unreadable',str(result))
+    case('partial-failed-listing',partial)
+
+    def overlimit(f):
+        inject(f,'''if [ "$1" = lsjson ]; then python3 -c 'import json;print(json.dumps([dict(Path="f"+str(n),IsDir=False) for n in range(4097)]))'; exit 0; fi''')
+        require(rows(request(f,'saves',rc=5))['saves']['state']=='unreadable','oversize entries accepted')
+    case('entry-limit',overlimit)
+
+    def byte_limit(f):
+        inject(f,'''if [ "$1" = lsjson ]; then python3 -c 'print("x"*2200000)'; exit 0; fi''')
+        require(rows(request(f,'saves',rc=5))['saves']['state']=='unreadable','oversize bytes accepted')
+    case('byte-limit',byte_limit)
+
+    def malformed(f):
+        inject(f,'''if [ "$1" = lsjson ]; then printf '[{"Path":"../escape.srm","IsDir":false}]'; exit 0; fi''')
+        require(rows(request(f,'saves',rc=5))['saves']['state']=='unreadable','unsafe listing accepted')
+    case('malformed-listing',malformed)
+
+    def context(f):
+        one=json.loads(f.run('cloud_setup','--validation-context').stdout)
+        f.conf('/Other/Saves','/Keep/Backups','Rel/Content')
+        two=json.loads(f.run('cloud_setup','--validation-context').stdout)
+        require(one['config_id']!=two['config_id'],'path change same ID')
+        c=f.path/'storage/.config/rclone/rclone.conf';c.write_text(c.read_text()+'# reconfigured\n')
+        three=json.loads(f.run('cloud_setup','--validation-context').stdout)
+        require(two['config_id']!=three['config_id'],'remote config change same ID')
+        require(three['paths']['roms']=='Rel/Content/ROMs',str(three))
+        require(not any(l.startswith('ls') and not l.startswith('listremotes') for l in (f.path/'ctl/argv').read_text().splitlines()),'context made network calls')
+    case('context-binding-local-only',context)
+
+    def info_paths(f):
+        f.conf('Chosen/Saves','Separate/Archives','/Library')
+        put(f.path/'shim/get_setting','#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n',True)
+        r=f.run('cloud_setup','--info');require(r.returncode==0,r.stdout)
+        require('SETTINGS_REMOTE=Separate/Archives\n' in r.stdout and 'CONTENT_REMOTE=/Library\n' in r.stdout,r.stdout)
+    case('info-independent-paths',info_paths)
+
+
+    def stale(f):
+        inject(f,'''if [ "$1" = lsjson ]; then printf '\\n# concurrent configuration edit\\n' >> /storage/.config/cloud_sync.conf; fi''')
+        r=f.run('cloud_setup','--validate-folders','saves','stale01');v=json.loads(r.stdout)
+        require(r.returncode==5 and v['error']=='configuration-changed' and not v['complete'],str(v))
+    case('stale-configuration-refused',stale)
+
+    def invalid(f):
+        before=snapshot(f)
+        for categories,run in [('','a'),('saves,','a'),('saves,saves','a'),('invalid','a'),('saves','../a'),('saves','x'*65)]:
+            r=f.run('cloud_setup','--validate-folders',categories,run)
+            require(r.returncode==2,'invalid args accepted')
+        require(snapshot(f)==before,'invalid args mutated state')
+        for categories in ('settings\nroms','saves,saves','saves,','unknown',' saves'):
+            r=f.run('cloud_setup','--seed-folders',categories)
+            require(r.returncode==2,'invalid seed category accepted')
+        require(snapshot(f)==before,'invalid seed mutated bytes')
+        require(not (f.path/'ctl/argv').exists(),'invalid args invoked rclone')
+    case('invalid-input-refused',invalid)
+
+    def invalid_setters(f):
+        before=snapshot(f)
+        for setter in ('--set-saves-remote','--set-settings-remote','--set-content-remote'):
+            for bad in ('.','..','./x','../x','x/../y','x//y','x\n','x$HOME'):
+                r=f.run('cloud_setup',setter,bad)
+                require(r.returncode!=0, 'unsafe setter accepted '+repr((setter,bad)))
+        require(snapshot(f)==before, 'refused setter changed bytes')
+    case('invalid-paths-refused',invalid_setters)
+
+    def deep(f):
+        f.file('pixelelated/Saves/nested/a/b/c/progress.srm')
+        result=request(f,'saves',rc=5)
+        require(rows(result)['saves']['detail']=='deeper-folders-not-checked',str(result))
+    case('deeper-than-bound-not-empty',deep)
+
+    def content_location(f):
+        f.file('ROMs/gb/root-game.gb');f.file('pixelelated/Content/ROMs/gb/chosen.gb')
+        before=snapshot(f)
+        r=f.run('cloud_setup','--content-location');require(r.returncode==0 and 'STATE=ok' in r.stdout,r.stdout)
+        require(snapshot(f)==before,'location mutated bytes')
+        require('lsjson qa: ' not in (f.path/'ctl/argv').read_text(),'account-root discovery')
+    case('content-location-selected-only',content_location)
+
+
+    def independent(f):
+        f.conf('/GAMES','/GAMES/backup','Different/Content')
+        before=snapshot(f)
+        r=f.run('cloud_setup','--set-saves-remote','New/Saves');require(r.returncode==0,r.stdout)
+        q=f.pointers();require(q['SAVES_REMOTE']=='New/Saves' and q['SETTINGS_REMOTE']=='/GAMES/backup' and q['CONTENT_REMOTE']=='Different/Content',str(q))
+        r=f.run('cloud_setup','--set-settings-remote','Settings');require(r.returncode==0,r.stdout)
+        q=f.pointers();require(q['SETTINGS_REMOTE']=='Settings' and q['SAVES_REMOTE']=='New/Saves' and q['CONTENT_REMOTE']=='Different/Content',str(q))
+        require(not any(k.startswith('cloud/') for k in snapshot(f)),'selection mutated cloud')
+    case('independent-pointer-selection',independent)
+
+    def seeds(f):
+        f.file('pixelelated/Saves/gb/progress.srm','retained')
+        before=snapshot(f)
+        require(f.run('cloud_setup','--seed-folders').returncode==2,'implicit seeding allowed')
+        r=f.run('cloud_setup','--seed-folders','settings');require(r.returncode==0,r.stdout)
+        after=snapshot(f);require(all(after.get(k)==v for k,v in before.items()),'seed replaced bytes')
+        require((f.path/'cloud/pixelelated/Backups/README.txt').exists(),'missing selected seed')
+        require(not (f.path/'cloud/pixelelated/Content').exists(),'disabled content created')
+        require(not (f.path/'cloud/pixelelated/Saves/savefiles').exists(),'disabled saves folders created')
+        r=f.run('cloud_setup','--seed-folders','roms');require(r.returncode==0,r.stdout)
+        require(not (f.path/'cloud/pixelelated/Content/BIOS').exists(),'disabled BIOS created')
+    case('explicit-category-seeding',seeds)
+
+    def namespace(f):
+        f.conf('Mine/Saves','Mine/Settings','Mine/Content')
+        r=f.run('cloud_setup','--seed-folders','saves,settings,roms,bios');require(r.returncode==0,r.stdout)
+        result=request(f);require(result['complete'],str(result))
+        argv=(f.path/'ctl/argv').read_text()
+        require('qa:/Mine' not in argv,'relative namespace changed to absolute')
+        require('lsjson qa: ' not in argv,'unselected root scanned')
+    case('relative-namespace-preserved',namespace)
+
+    def distinct_roots(f):
+        # The real alias backend normalizes leading slash. Map the two rclone
+        # namespaces to separate real local trees instead, as SFTP does.
+        inject(f,'''mapped=()
+for arg in "$@"; do
+ case "$arg" in
+  qa:/*) mapped+=(":local:/cloud/absolute/${arg#qa:/}") ;;
+  qa:*) mapped+=(":local:/cloud/relative/${arg#qa:}") ;;
+  *) mapped+=("$arg") ;;
+ esac
+done
+if [ "$1" = lsf ] && [ "$2" = qa:/ ] && { [ -e /ctl/absolute-unreadable ] || [ -e /ctl/root-seeded ]; }; then exit 5; fi
+/rclone.real "${mapped[@]}"; rc=$?
+if [ "$1" = copyto ] && [ "$rc" = 0 ] && [ -e /ctl/fail-seed-readback ]; then touch /ctl/root-seeded; fi
+exit "$rc"''')
+        f.directory('absolute');f.file('relative/owner-note.txt','home namespace sentinel')
+        f.conf('/','/','/Library')
+        put(f.path/'ctl/absolute-unreadable','yes')
+        r=f.run('cloud_setup','--folder-state')
+        require(r.returncode!=0,'unreadable absolute root was reported ready by reading relative home: '+r.stdout)
+        (f.path/'ctl/absolute-unreadable').unlink()
+        r=f.run('cloud_setup','--folder-state');require(r.returncode==0 and 'STATE=ready' in r.stdout,r.stdout)
+        put(f.path/'ctl/fail-seed-readback','yes')
+        r=f.run('cloud_setup','--seed-folders','settings')
+        require(r.returncode!=0 and (f.path/'ctl/root-seeded').exists(),'absolute-root readback used relative home: '+r.stdout)
+        require((f.path/'cloud/absolute/README.txt').exists(),'absolute note was not created')
+        require((f.path/'cloud/relative/owner-note.txt').read_text()=='home namespace sentinel','relative home was changed')
+    case('absolute-relative-root-distinction',distinct_roots)
+
+    def root(f):
+        f.conf('/Saves','/Backups','')
+        r=f.run('cloud_setup','--seed-folders','roms,bios');require(r.returncode==0,r.stdout)
+        c=json.loads(f.run('cloud_setup','--validation-context').stdout)
+        require(c['paths']['roms']=='ROMs',str(c))
+        request(f,'roms,bios')
+        argv=(f.path/'ctl/argv').read_text();require('lsjson qa: ' in argv,'explicit root not inspected')
+        require('qa:/ROMs' not in argv,'relative root changed to absolute')
+    case('explicit-root-allowed',root)
+
+    def public_adoption(f, content=None):
+        ref='c445081a59518f37d9776e5412dd7b14910696f7'
+        public=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(ROOT),'show',ref+':projects/ROCKNIX/packages/network/rclone/sources/cloud_sync.conf'])
+        (f.path/'storage/.config/cloud_sync.conf').write_bytes(public + (('\nCONTENT_REMOTE="'+content+'"\n').encode() if content is not None else b''))
+        before_credential=(f.path/'storage/.config/rclone/rclone.conf').read_bytes()
+        f.file('GAMES/gb/progress.srm');f.file('GAMES/backup/existing.zip')
+        before_cloud={k:v for k,v in snapshot(f).items() if k.startswith('cloud/')}
+        cmd=['bwrap','--die-with-parent','--unshare-pid','--tmpfs','/',
+             '--dir','/usr',
+             '--ro-bind','/usr/bin','/usr/bin','--ro-bind','/usr/lib','/usr/lib','--ro-bind','/usr/lib64','/usr/lib64','--ro-bind','/usr/share','/usr/share',
+             '--symlink','usr/bin','/bin','--symlink','usr/lib','/lib','--symlink','usr/lib64','/lib64',
+             '--ro-bind','/etc','/etc','--ro-bind',str(f.path/'profile'),'/etc/profile',
+             '--ro-bind',str(f.path/'repo'),'/usr/config',
+             '--ro-bind',a.rclone,'/rclone.real','--dev','/dev','--proc','/proc','--tmpfs','/tmp']
+        for folder,guest in [('repo','/repo'),('shim','/shim'),('storage','/storage'),('cloud','/cloud'),('ctl','/ctl'),('log','/var/log'),('run','/var/run')]:
+            cmd+=['--bind',str(f.path/folder),guest]
+        cmd+=['--setenv','HOME','/storage','--setenv','PATH','/shim:/repo:/usr/bin:/bin','bash','/repo/cloud_sync_helper']
+        r=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=15)
+        (f.path/'adoption.log').write_text(r.stdout)
+        (f.path/'adoption-result.json').write_text(json.dumps({'rc':r.returncode,'public_ref':ref,'public_conf_sha256':hashlib.sha256(public).hexdigest(),'pointers':f.pointers()},indent=2))
+        require(r.returncode==0,r.stdout)
+        q=f.pointers();require(q.get('SAVES_REMOTE')=='/GAMES' and q.get('SETTINGS_REMOTE')=='/GAMES/backup',str(q))
+        require(q.get('CONTENT_REMOTE')==('/pixelelated/Content' if content is None else content),'content choice not preserved/defaulted: '+str(q.get('CONTENT_REMOTE')))
+        require((f.path/'storage/.config/rclone/rclone.conf').read_bytes()==before_credential,'credentials changed')
+        require({k:v for k,v in snapshot(f).items() if k.startswith('cloud/')}==before_cloud,'adoption relocated cloud bytes')
+        result=request(f,'saves,settings')
+        require(rows(result)['saves']['path']=='/GAMES' and rows(result)['settings']['path']=='/GAMES/backup',str(result))
+    case('public-rocknix-config-adoption',public_adoption)
+    case('public-rocknix-explicit-root-preserved',lambda f:public_adoption(f,''))
+    case('public-rocknix-custom-library-preserved',lambda f:public_adoption(f,'Separate/Library'))
+
+    def timeout(f):
+        inject(f,'''if [ "$1" = lsjson ]; then sleep 12; fi''')
+        require(rows(request(f,'saves',rc=5))['saves']['state']=='unreadable','unbounded request')
+    case('request-timeout',timeout)
+
+    sources=ROOT/'projects/ROCKNIX/packages/network/rclone/sources'
+    (a.output/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps({'result':'PASS','cases':results,'rclone_version':version,'rclone_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(a.rclone).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'source_sha256':{n:hashlib.sha256(subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(ROOT),'show',a.ref+':projects/ROCKNIX/packages/network/rclone/sources/'+n]) if a.ref else (sources/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in ['cloud_setup','cloud_folder_validate','cloud_content_restore','cloud_sync_helper']}},indent=2)+'\n')
+    print(f'PASS {len(results)} controls')
+
+if __name__=='__main__':main()
diff --git a/tools/pixelelated-content-scope-test b/tools/pixelelated-content-scope-test

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Exercise selected-library boundaries with production scripts and real rclone.
+
+Host source controls for #508/#510, not firmware or VM qualification. Each
+case gets independent synthetic configuration, cloud files, and result logs.
+"""
+import argparse
+import fcntl
+import hashlib
+import importlib.machinery
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument('--source-root', type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--rclone', required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--cases', help='Comma-separated case names; use for unfixed controls')
+    parser.add_argument('--fixture-tool', type=Path,
+                        default=Path(__file__).with_name('rasteratops-cloud-layout-test'))
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    args.source_root = args.source_root.resolve()
+    args.rclone = str(Path(args.rclone).resolve(strict=True))
+    args.ref = None
+    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    loader = importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader('layout_fixture', str(args.fixture_tool))
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_loader(loader.name, loader)
+    fixture = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    loader.exec_module(fixture)
+    results = []
+
+    def snapshot(path):
+        return {str(p.relative_to(path)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+                for p in path.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
+
+    def case(name, run):
+        if args.cases and name not in args.cases.split(','):
+            return
+        f = fixture.Fixture(args.output / name, args)
+        f.conf(content='/Chosen/Library')
+        fixture.put(f.path / 'storage/roms/gb/.keep', '')
+        # Independent distracting libraries, both flat and structured.
+        for path in ['gb/Outside.gb', 'Other/ROMs/gb/Other.gb',
+                     'Chosen/Library/gb/Flat.gb', 'bios/Outside.bin']:
+            f.file(path, 'unselected ' + path)
+        before = snapshot(f.path / 'cloud')
+        try:
+            fixture.put(f.path/'repo/fixture-check', "printf '%s\\n' isolated-fixture-ready\n")
+            ready = f.run('fixture-check')
+            fixture.require(ready.returncode == 0 and ready.stdout.strip() == 'isolated-fixture-ready',
+                            'isolated fixture did not start: ' + ready.stdout)
+            run(f)
+            fixture.require(snapshot(f.path / 'cloud') == before,
+                            'read/restore changed remote files')
+            results.append({'case': name, 'result': 'PASS'})
+            print('PASS', name, flush=True)
+        except Exception as error:
+            results.append({'case': name, 'result': 'FAIL', 'error': str(error)})
+            print('FAIL', name, str(error), flush=True)
+
+    def absent(f, mode):
+        r = f.run('cloud_content_restore', mode)
+        fixture.require(r.returncode == 0, r.stdout)
+        if mode == '--list':
+            fixture.require(not r.stdout.strip(), 'unselected folders were offered')
+        if mode == '--scan':
+            rows = [line.split('|') for line in r.stdout.splitlines() if '|' in line]
+            fixture.require(all(row[1] == '0' for row in rows), 'unselected cloud bytes counted')
+        fixture.require(not (f.path / 'storage/roms/gb/Flat.gb').exists(),
+                        'flat library restored without selection')
+        fixture.require(not (f.path / 'storage/roms/gb/Outside.gb').exists(),
+                        'account-root library restored')
+        calls = (f.path / 'ctl/argv').read_text().splitlines()
+        for line in calls:
+            if line.startswith(('lsf ', 'copy ', 'sync ')):
+                fixture.require('qa:/Chosen/Library' in line,
+                                'remote access escaped selected library: ' + line)
+
+    for mode in ['--list', '--scan', '--all']:
+        case('missing-' + mode[2:], lambda f, mode=mode: absent(f, mode))
+
+    def selected(f):
+        f.file('Chosen/Library/ROMs/gb/Chosen.gb', 'chosen ROM bytes')
+        f.file('Chosen/Library/BIOS/Required.bin', 'chosen BIOS bytes')
+        # Those are fixtures too; return them to the initial snapshot after
+        # checking exact local bytes, so the common read-only oracle applies.
+        before = snapshot(f.path / 'cloud')
+        r = f.run('cloud_content_restore', '--all')
+        fixture.require(r.returncode == 0, r.stdout[-1000:])
+        fixture.require((f.path / 'storage/roms/gb/Chosen.gb').read_text() == 'chosen ROM bytes',
+                        'selected ROM bytes missing')
+        fixture.require((f.path / 'storage/roms/bios/Required.bin').read_text() == 'chosen BIOS bytes',
+                        'selected BIOS bytes missing')
+        fixture.require(snapshot(f.path / 'cloud') == before, 'restore changed cloud')
+        (f.path / 'cloud/Chosen/Library/ROMs/gb/Chosen.gb').unlink()
+        (f.path / 'cloud/Chosen/Library/BIOS/Required.bin').unlink()
+        fixture.require(not (f.path / 'storage/roms/gb/Flat.gb').exists(), 'flat fallback used')
+
+    case('selected-rom-bios-bytes', selected)
+
+    def failed(f, mode, partial):
+        if partial:
+            shim = f.path / 'shim/rclone'
+            text = shim.read_text()
+            text = text.replace("printf '%s\\n' \"$*\" >> /ctl/argv",
+                                "printf '%s\\n' \"$*\" >> /ctl/argv\n"
+                                "if [ \"$1\" = lsf ]; then echo '99|gb/Partial.gb'; exit 3; fi")
+            # Verify fault installation rather than a vacuous error case.
+            fixture.require('Partial.gb' in text, 'could not install partial-list fault')
+            shim.write_text(text)
+        else:
+            f.fault('^lsf ', 5)
+        r = f.run('cloud_content_restore', mode)
+        fixture.require(r.returncode != 0, 'provider failure looked like success: ' + r.stdout)
+        fixture.require(not any(p.name.endswith('.gb') for p in (f.path/'storage/roms').rglob('*')),
+                        'failure caused an unintended restore')
+        calls = (f.path/'ctl/argv').read_text()
+        fixture.require(not any(line.startswith(('copy ', 'sync ')) for line in calls.splitlines()),
+                        'failed discovery started a transfer')
+
+    for mode in ['--list', '--scan', '--all']:
+        case('unreadable-' + mode[2:], lambda f, mode=mode: failed(f, mode, False))
+        case('partial-' + mode[2:], lambda f, mode=mode: failed(f, mode, True))
+
+    def traversal(f):
+        r = f.run('cloud_content_restore', '../gb')
+        fixture.require(r.returncode != 0, 'relative traversal accepted')
+        calls = (f.path/'ctl/argv').read_text()
+        fixture.require(not any(line.startswith(('copy ', 'sync ')) for line in calls.splitlines()),
+                        'traversal started transfer')
+    case('system-traversal-refused', traversal)
+
+    def scan_binding(f):
+        r = f.run('cloud_scan', '--content', '--run-id', 'scope-one')
+        fixture.require(r.returncode == 0, r.stdout)
+        stamp = json.loads((f.path/'storage/.cache/cloud_sync/scan/content-done').read_text())
+        fixture.require(isinstance(stamp, dict), 'completion is not bound to a run/configuration')
+        fixture.require(stamp['run_id'] == 'scope-one', 'wrong scan identity')
+        fixture.require(f.run('cloud_scan', '--stamp-valid', 'content-done', 'scope-one').returncode == 0,
+                        'current scan refused')
+        fixture.require(f.run('cloud_scan', '--stamp-valid', 'content-done', 'other-run').returncode != 0,
+                        'another scan was accepted')
+        fixture.require(f.run('cloud_scan', '--stamp-valid', 'content-done', 'scope-one', '--media-only').returncode != 0,
+                        'another category selection was accepted')
+        rows = f.path/'storage/.cache/cloud_sync/scan/scan'
+        rows.write_text(rows.read_text()+'gb|99|1|0|0|0|0|0\n')
+        fixture.require(f.run('cloud_scan', '--stamp-valid', 'content-done', 'scope-one').returncode != 0,
+                        'mutated cached output accepted')
+
+    case('scan-run-mode-output-binding', scan_binding)
+
+    def changed_configuration(f):
+        r = f.run('cloud_scan', '--content', '--run-id', 'scope-two')
+        fixture.require(r.returncode == 0, r.stdout)
+        f.conf(content='/Different/Library')
+        fixture.require(f.run('cloud_scan', '--stamp-valid', 'content-done', 'scope-two').returncode != 0,
+                        'old result accepted after folder change')
+
+    case('scan-folder-change-invalidates', changed_configuration)
+
+    def changed_endpoint(f):
+        r = f.run('cloud_scan', '--content', '--run-id', 'scope-three')
+        fixture.require(r.returncode == 0, r.stdout)
+        fixture.put(f.path/'storage/.config/rclone/rclone.conf', '[qa]\ntype = alias\nremote = /different-cloud\n')
+        fixture.require(f.run('cloud_scan', '--stamp-valid', 'content-done', 'scope-three').returncode != 0,
+                        'old result accepted after endpoint change')
+
+    case('scan-endpoint-change-invalidates', changed_endpoint)
+
+    def local_context(f):
+        before = snapshot(f.path/'storage')
+        r = f.run('cloud_scan', '--context')
+        fixture.require(r.returncode == 0 and len(r.stdout.strip()) == 64, 'invalid local context')
+        fixture.require(not (f.path/'ctl/argv').exists(), 'local context started rclone')
+        fixture.require(snapshot(f.path/'storage') == before, 'local context changed config/cache')
+        fixture.require(f.run('cloud_scan', '--stamp-valid', '../../outside', 'scope').returncode != 0,
+                        'arbitrary stamp path accepted')
+
+    case('scan-context-local-read-only', local_context)
+
+    def scan_lock(f):
+        cache = f.path/'storage/.cache/cloud_sync/scan'
+        fixture.put(cache/'done', 'another owner\n')
+        fixture.put(cache/'state', 'retained cache\n')
+        before = snapshot(cache)
+        with (f.path/'run/cloud_scan.lock').open('w') as lock:
+            fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
+            r = f.run('cloud_scan', '--run-id', 'second-owner')
+        fixture.require(r.returncode == 75, 'concurrent scan was not refused')
+        fixture.require(snapshot(cache) == before, 'refused scan altered another owner cache')
+        fixture.require(not (f.path/'ctl/argv').exists(), 'refused scan contacted cloud')
+
+    case('scan-concurrent-owner-refused', scan_lock)
+
+    def unreadable_during_scan(f):
+        shim = f.path/'shim/rclone'
+        s = shim.read_text().replace('exec /rclone.real "$@"',
+                                    "printf '\\n# changed while checking\\n' >> /storage/.config/cloud_sync.conf\n"
+                                    'exec /rclone.real "$@"')
+        shim.write_text(s)
+        r = f.run('cloud_scan', '--content', '--run-id', 'changing-config')
+        fixture.require(r.returncode != 0, 'configuration changed during scan but completion succeeded')
+        fixture.require(not (f.path/'storage/.cache/cloud_sync/scan/content-done').exists(),
+                        'failed scan wrote completion')
+
+    case('scan-config-changes-during-run', unreadable_during_scan)
+
+    def trailing_slash(f):
+        f.conf(content='/Chosen/Library/')
+        absent(f, '--list')
+
+    case('selected-trailing-slash', trailing_slash)
+
+    def pointer_traversal(f):
+        f.conf(content='../Other')
+        r = f.run('cloud_content_restore', '--list')
+        fixture.require(r.returncode != 0, 'traversing content pointer accepted')
+        calls = (f.path/'ctl/argv').read_text()
+        fixture.require(not any(line.startswith(('lsf ', 'copy ', 'sync ')) for line in calls.splitlines()),
+                        'traversing pointer read a cloud folder')
+
+    case('content-pointer-traversal-refused', pointer_traversal)
+
+    def root_refusal(f, root):
+        f.conf(content=root)
+        f.fault('^lsf ', 5)
+        fixture.put(f.path/'repo/root-refusal', 'timeout 2 bash /repo/cloud_content_restore --list\n')
+        r = f.run('root-refusal')
+        fixture.require(r.returncode not in (0, 124),
+                        'unreadable selected root did not refuse promptly: ' + str(r.returncode))
+        calls = (f.path/'ctl/argv').read_text().splitlines()
+        listing = [row.split()[2] for row in calls if row.startswith('lsf --dirs-only ')]
+        selected = 'qa:' + root
+        fixture.require(listing and all(p in (selected, selected+'ROMs/') for p in listing),
+                        'selected namespace changed: ' + repr(listing))
+    case('relative-root-unreadable-bounded', lambda f: root_refusal(f, ''))
+    case('absolute-root-unreadable-bounded', lambda f: root_refusal(f, '/'))
+
+    sources = args.source_root / fixture.SOURCES
+    receipt = {'source_root': str(args.source_root),
+               'source_sha256': {name: hashlib.sha256((sources/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+                                 for name in ['cloud_content_restore', 'cloud_content_transfer', 'cloud_scan']},
+               'rclone_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(args.rclone).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+               'results': results}
+    (args.output/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2)+'\n')
+    if not results:
+        raise RuntimeError('No selected controls ran')
+    return int(any(row['result'] != 'PASS' for row in results))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    sys.exit(main())
diff --git a/tools/pixelelated-duckstation-capture-test b/tools/pixelelated-duckstation-capture-test
